statement:
∀ (a b Cg Cd : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (g d : KdVPlan.Path),
KdVPlan.MemH 2 f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b g Cg → KdVPlan.UB 0 a b d Cd →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) →
(∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => g r k) (d t k) t) →
∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) (3*KdVPlan.B t f (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t f (d t) k) t
proof:
intro a b Cg Cd f g d hf hzf hg hd hzg hder t ht k
have hi := yui_aux_0060 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hkform := yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
by_cases hk : k=0
· subst k
  have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) 0) = fun _ => (0:ℂ) := by
    funext r; simp [(hkform r f (g r) 0).2]
  rw [heq]
  have hzB := (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 t f (g t)
  simpa [show KdVPlan.B t f (g t) 0=0 from hzB,(hkform t f (d t) 0).2] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0:ℂ))
have hfL := (yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 f hf
have hgb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖g r c‖≤Cg := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hg r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hdb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ c, ‖d r c‖≤Cd := by
  intro r hr c
  exact ((yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 _ (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).1 c).trans (hd r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2.le⟩).2
have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g t 0)).trans (hgb t ht 0)
have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (d t 0)).trans (hdb t ht 0)
let v : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j)
let v' : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j r => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)+KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)
have hnorm : ‖(3:ℂ)*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)‖=3*|(k:ℝ)| := by simp [norm_mul,Complex.norm_intCast]
have hbnd : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → ‖v' j r‖ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
  intro j r hr
  have hp := (hi.1 (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r).2
  have hiff := hi.2.1 f j
  have hidd := (hi.2.1 (d r) (k-j)).trans (hdb r hr (k-j))
  dsimp [v']
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*f j*g r (k-j)‖+
      ‖KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)*‖f j‖ := by
      simp only [norm_mul,hp,one_mul]
      have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
      rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb r hr (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)| *‖f j‖),
        mul_le_mul hiff hidd (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
have hvder : ∀ j r, r∈Ioo a b → HasDerivAt (v j) (v' j r) r := by
  intro j r hr
  have hgder : HasDerivAt (fun s => KdVPlan.invD (g s) (k-j)) (KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j)) r := by
    by_cases hc : k-j=0
    · simp only [KdVPlan.invD,if_pos hc]
      exact hasDerivAt_const r 0
    · simpa only [KdVPlan.invD,if_neg hc] using (hder r hr (k-j)).const_mul ((Complex.I*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ))⁻¹)
  have hv := (((hi.1 (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r).1).mul_const (KdVPlan.invD f j)).mul hgder
  apply hv.congr_deriv
  dsimp [v,v']
  symm
  have hc := hi.2.2 k j f (g r) hzf (hzg r hr)
  calc
    _ = KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r *
      ((-Complex.I*((3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ):ℝ):ℂ))*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (g r) (k-j))+
      KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) r*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d r) (k-j) := by rw [hc]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring
have hsum0 : Summable (fun j => v j t) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cg)
  intro j
  dsimp [v]
  rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖f j‖*Cg := mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (g t) (k-j)).trans (hgb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring
have htSum := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg+Cd)) isOpen_Ioo (convex_Ioo a b).isPreconnected hvder hbnd ht hsum0 ht
have heq : (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f (g r) k) = (fun r => ∑' j, v j r) := by
  funext r; simpa [v,hk] using (hkform r f (g r) k).2
rw [heq]
apply htSum.congr_deriv
symm
rw [(hkform t f (g t) k).1,(hkform t f (d t) k).2,if_neg hk]
have hs1 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => 3*Complex.I*(k:ℂ)*KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*f j*g t (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left (3*|(k:ℝ)| *Cg))
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,mul_one]
  have hn3 : ‖(3:ℂ)‖=3 := by norm_num
  rw [hn3,Complex.norm_I,Complex.norm_intCast]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb t ht (k-j)) (by positivity : 0≤3*|(k:ℝ)| *‖f j‖)
  nlinarith
have hs2 : Summable (fun j : ℤ => KdVPlan.phase (3*(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*((k-j:ℤ):ℝ)) t*KdVPlan.invD f j*KdVPlan.invD (d t) (k-j)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfL.mul_left Cd)
  intro j
  simp only [norm_mul,(hi.1 _ t).2,one_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul (hi.2.1 f j) ((hi.2.1 (d t) (k-j)).trans (hdb t ht _)) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
rw [show (∑' j, v' j t) = _ from hs1.tsum_add hs2]
congr 1
rw [← tsum_mul_left,← tsum_mul_left]
apply tsum_congr; intro j; ring
